thread_title: New player running into a wall for the finale of act 1

content: 1. 9-12 Ant has a few hidden mechanics that are not widely known. One of these are the blood pools at the very end of the stage. Unlike others, these blood pools allow you to gain an increased permanent health boost in exchange for gaining symptoms. This allows you to buff up your hp to ludicrous amounts (4k-5k) if done properly. It's a very very strong mechanic that can synergizes especially well with your Caro team since a direct hp buff directly increases your crimson furnace capacity. Additionally, you can self cleanse the symptoms after with a wheel like Vitality. I highly recommend you use the wheel "Gluttony" as well since it gives a 44% multiplicative hp boost which stacks with the blood pools at the end of the stage. If you want even more survivability, use an aequor unit as their white stance shield will benefit from the hp boost too. Finally, you could be running some death resistance covenants (burial ground sigh) to further increase your survivability. For that fight, Ghelot struggles a decent amount due to the discard mechanic. I'd suggest replacing her with another dps for that particular fight.
thread_title: New player running into a wall for the finale of act 1

content: 2. Level = General Stat Increase to hp, damage, and defense. Talents = more base damage and specific effects, you typically want all of these (besides the exalt) leveled to 3 since they are cheap to do. Gnostic advances are extra upgrades given to standard characters for standard pulls, generally not recommended at all for new players. Soulforge aptitude (sf) are levels that affect the astral reign stages (arc 2), they are very very strong as they result in huge stat buffs for your characters. They do not affect arc 1
thread_title: New player running into a wall for the finale of act 1

content: 3. Generally, events are the better usage of your energy as it will usually bring in more resources overtime. It's still important though to properly develop covenant pieces. For your purposes, you only really need the main stats on covenants to be good, and they can be general pieces too (you can't really go wrong with keyflare and death resistance)
